title_original: The Film Comment Podcast: Subscriber Exclusive: John Early on Maddie’s Secret, Part 2
excerpt_original: The actor-director returns to discuss his fantastic first feature, exclusively for Film Comment paid subscribers

blocks.text: A month ago, Film Comment Editor Devika Girish interviewed John Early on the Podcast about his fantastic first feature, Maddie’s Secret , about a food influencer, played by John, who secretly struggles with bulimia. Even though the two chatted for nearly an hour about the film’s various influences, from TV movies to erotic thrillers, and John’s delicately balanced performance, they had a lot more to talk about. So John and Devika reunited for a Part 2 exclusively for Film Comment paid subscribers. John reflected on how his understanding of his own movie had changed since we last spoke before the release, what it’s been like taking the film on tour throughout the country, the lessons he’s taken away from the film’s occasional detractors, and more.
Thank you for subscribing to Film Comment , and we hope you enjoy the conversation!
